baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِن نَّحْنُ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ ... يَمُنُّ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The messengers retain the shared human category and locate the differentiating event outside themselves: divine favor selects within servanthood without cancelling human likeness.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary human category supplies the common substrate shared by speakers and hearers.
Likeness and equivalence make human parity explicit rather than something the messengers evade.
Bestowal supplies the differentiating benefit while keeping its source with the benefactor.
Will attaches selection to the thing willed rather than to an inherent messenger entitlement.
Submissive service contains the selected person inside continuing obedience.

changed_reading.before: The speakers answer an objection by claiming a superior kind of person.
changed_reading.after: They concede full human likeness; the only distinction asserted is a contingent divine bestowal within continued servanthood.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا أَن نَّأْتِيَكُم بِسُلْطَانٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The modal denial removes autonomous production from the messengers. A compelling proof or authority may arrive through them only when divine license opens the route.

activation_trace.role: The messenger is a carrier of a message, fitting mediated rather than self-originating authority.
Coming presents the sultan as something brought to the hearers, not possessed as the messenger's essence.
A compelling proof supplies the evidentiary force being demanded.
Power and jurisdiction keep a second live sense of authority alongside proof.
Permission is the explicit gate that makes any arrival of sultan licit and possible.

changed_reading.before: The messengers merely decline to perform a requested sign on demand.
changed_reading.after: They define a delegated-authority boundary: neither proof nor power originates in them, and any arrival through them remains permission-bound.

baseline_models.mechanism: Messenger non-autonomy does not terminate in uncertainty. Believers transfer the affair and its outcome to God, combining settled confidence with reliance on the one who keeps and manages the affair.

activation_trace.role: Entrusting the affair supplies the directional transfer away from human control.
The one who sufficiently keeps an affair supplies the positive object of reliance, not mere relinquishment.
Heart-settling security makes trust the posture characteristic of believers.
Assured assent joins reliance to conviction rather than helplessness.

changed_reading.before: Believers are told generally to be pious and hopeful.
changed_reading.after: They are told to relocate control of the contested mission from human agents to God's sufficient keeping.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier context gives permission an operative pattern: an ordinary linguistic message moves people outward into illumination by permission. The focus denial therefore marks not only who authorizes sultan but how a human conduit can have effects it does not own.

activation_trace.role: Humanity anchors the conduit in the ordinary human category.
Compelling proof is the effect whose autonomous production the messenger denies.
License explicitly gates the coming of that proof.
Passage outward supplies the mission's movement from one condition into another.
Illumination supplies the destination and visible effect of the permitted movement.
The same licensing image governs the book-mediated movement before it governs sultan.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign specifies the human messenger's operative means.

structural_cues: 14:1 places 'by permission of their Lord' inside the movement from darkness to light.
14:4 places sending in a people's tongue before the purpose of clarification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permitted outward movement, illumination, and tongue-based clarification; I infer that permission gates the efficacy of ordinary human speech, not only its legality. A live alternative is that permission marks authorization alone without specifying a causal channel.

changed_reading.before: The exception means only that God must authorize a requested proof.
changed_reading.after: Permission is also the efficacy gate by which ordinary human speech can disclose, move, and illuminate without becoming autonomous power.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remembered favor is followed by gratitude and increase, while God is described as independent of universal rejection. Divine bestowal in the focus thus becomes a benefit that calls for a servant's response, not prestige that supplies anything God lacks.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal places the selected messenger under the weight and acknowledgment of received benefit.
Obedient service supplies the recipient posture of the bestowed role.
Good condition and favor give concrete historical content to divine benefit.
Recognition of favor and praise of its giver supplies the beneficiary's fitting response.
Growth makes received favor dynamic rather than a static rank.
Divine independence blocks construing messenger service as filling a divine need.

structural_cues: 14:6 names divine favor while recounting rescue from abusive rule.
14:7 orders gratitude, increase, rejection, and severe consequence.
14:8 says universal rejection would leave God independent and praiseworthy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies favor, gratitude, growth, and divine independence; I infer an arrow from selection to accountable service rather than status. A live alternative is that the gratitude sequence concerns rescued communities generally and only analogically sharpens messenger selection.

changed_reading.before: God's favor simply marks which humans receive messenger status.
changed_reading.after: Selection is received benefit that intensifies servanthood and grateful responsibility while adding nothing to an independent God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opponents first encounter clarifying signs, then formulate human likeness as a disqualifying objection and demand clear sultan. The messengers answer by repeating the objection's own human-likeness formula but reversing its entailment: likeness remains true while divine favor and permission explain mission and authority.

activation_trace.role: Meaning disclosed by signs establishes that clarification preceded the later demand.
The opponents use ordinary humanity as the premise of their disqualification.
Equivalence sharpens the premise into 'humans like us.'
Compelling proof is demanded as the condition for accepting an otherwise ordinary human carrier.
Explicit disclosure qualifies the demanded sultan as something expected to make the claim manifest.
The reply deliberately retains the opponents' human category.
The reply also retains equivalence rather than weakening it.
Divine bestowal supplies the missing distinction without changing species.
The demanded proof is accepted as a category but removed from messenger ownership.

structural_cues: 14:10 ends with 'you are only humans like us' and a demand for 'clear sultan'; 14:11 opens by repeating the human-likeness wording.
The adversarial claim is therefore immediately converted into the reply's conceded premise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent lexical repetition and changed speaker; I infer a deliberate rhetorical concession that reverses the opponents' conclusion. A live alternative is simple quotation-like repetition without a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: The messengers defend themselves against the accusation of being ordinary humans.
changed_reading.after: They appropriate the accusation as true and reject only its inference: equal humanity does not exclude a permission-bound divine commission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation repeats entrustment, ties it to already-given paths, and joins it to patient endurance of harm. The later assurance concerning God's promise to the messengers supplies a future ground for that posture. Trust is therefore continued guided action under coercion, not withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: Entrusting the affair establishes the focus command whose operation context reveals.
Settled security identifies the trusting community.
Repeated entrustment turns the focus command into the speakers' enacted stance.
Gentle direction to a path supplies prior orientation for action.
Traversable paths make trust compatible with continuing movement.
Holding the self from collapse under harm gives trust its resistant temporal form.
A promise that opens hope supplies a future object for endurance.
The promise is structurally attached to the message-bearing agents whose trust is contested.

structural_cues: 14:12 immediately repeats trust twice, recalls guidance, and vows patience under harm.
14:13 follows with the threat of expulsion or forced return.
14:47 denies that God will fail the promise made to the messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trust, guided paths, endurance, threat, and promise; I infer that the promise grounds sustained action while outcomes are entrusted to God. A live alternative is that the promise is eschatological reassurance without being the immediate causal ground of 14:11-12 trust.

changed_reading.before: Reliance compensates emotionally for the messengers' inability to produce authority.
changed_reading.after: Reliance is a durable operating posture: follow given paths, withstand coercion, and entrust the promised outcome rather than cease acting.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later speaker denies having sultan over the hearers and reduces his role to calling, followed by their response. This separates communicative influence from coercive jurisdiction. In the focus, proof remains permission-bound and hearers remain answerable for how they answer it.

activation_trace.role: Compelling proof is the focus-side sultan whose arrival depends on permission.
License distinguishes the messengers' possible proof from self-owned jurisdiction.
Entrusting the affair to God follows the refusal of humanly owned sultan.
Power and jurisdiction supply the later authority explicitly denied over the responders.
A verbal call supplies influence that can occur without coercive sultan.
Answering speech locates the consequential uptake with the hearers.

structural_cues: 14:22 repeats the focus's 'I/we had no sultan over you' pattern with a different speaker.
Its exception names a call and the hearers' response rather than divine permission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel denials and a call-response sequence; I infer a contrast between permission-backed proof and non-coercive persuasion, leaving uptake answerable. A live alternative is that sultan means proof in both places rather than shifting toward jurisdiction in 14:22.

changed_reading.before: Sultan is any persuasive capacity that makes hearers accept a messenger.
changed_reading.after: Calling and being answered can occur without coercive sultan; the messenger may carry permitted proof, but neither messenger nor rival speaker owns the hearer's response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of a good word, rooted growth, fruit arriving by permission, and believers stabilized by firm speech offers a non-spectacular efficacy model for sultan. Authorized speech proves itself through durable grounding and yielded effects whose timing it does not control.

activation_trace.role: The messenger as carrier of a message anchors the later word mechanism back in the focus.
Compelling proof is reimagined as durable verbal efficacy rather than a messenger-owned display.
Permission anchors the shared efficacy condition.
An intelligible word supplies the communicative unit compared to organic growth.
Rootedness and stability supply durable grounding rather than momentary spectacle.
Giving makes the tree's effect an offered yield and echoes the focus's bringing construction.
The yield of tree or crop supplies the concrete effect produced by the good word.
The same licensing branch governs when the word-tree gives its yield.
Strengthening and stabilization make firm speech effective within believers.
Uttered speech carries the stabilizing content.
Assured believers are the recipients in whom the word's effect becomes durable.

structural_cues: 14:24 compares a good word to a tree with a stable root.
14:25 says that tree gives its yield at every interval by its Lord's permission.
14:27 joins believers, firm speech, and divine stabilization.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the word-tree sequence, permission-governed yield, and stabilized believers; I transfer that mechanism to the focus's permission-bound sultan. A live alternative is that the tree mechanism concerns good speech generally and does not specify what sultan denotes.

changed_reading.before: The requested sultan is chiefly a discrete overpowering exhibit.
changed_reading.after: A live alternative is permission-governed verbal proof: rooted speech yields effects over time and stabilizes believers without becoming the human carrier's power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing ayah names a communication reaching people and enumerates warning, knowing divine unity, and remembering. This supplies an endpoint for the focus's messenger and sultan language: delivery can reach its communicative goal without granting the carrier domination over response.

activation_trace.role: The message-bearing carrier anchors the closing delivery mechanism in the focus.
Proof remains the contested force whose communicative scope is being clarified.
Conveying a message to its destination supplies the mission's culminating task.
Warning that awakens caution supplies one non-coercive function of the delivered communication.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the cognitive effect sought by delivery.
Divine unity supplies the content to be known rather than an authority owned by the messenger.

structural_cues: The final ayah calls 'this' a communication for people and coordinates warning, knowing one deity, and remembering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a closing delivery with stated communicative effects; I identify it as the mission's endpoint and infer a boundary between reaching hearers and controlling them. A live alternative is that 'this' gathers the warning scene broadly without defining the focus's sultan.

changed_reading.before: Successful messenger authority would be measured by compelling acceptance.
changed_reading.after: The carrier's bounded success is delivery that reaches, warns, and discloses; domination of the hearer's response is not part of the granted office.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the cutting branch of م ن ن against the locally obvious bestowal branch. It remains anchored in يَمُنُّ and in the focus's explicit permission limit on sultan; downstream prose should present it only as a branch echo that bounds commission, never as a replacement translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَمُنُّ ... وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا أَن نَّأْتِيَكُم بِسُلْطَانٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ

activation_trace.role: Cutting or ending extension supplies an exploratory limit-image inside divine selection.
Will keeps both selection and its limit attached to the divine act.
Power and jurisdiction name the office whose extension is explicitly constrained.
Permission supplies the visible boundary past which delegated authority does not extend.

changed_reading.before: Favor adds an elevated capacity to an otherwise ordinary human.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch resonance, favor also cuts out a bounded commission: the selected human's authority terminates wherever permission does.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This social-legal activation is surprising because it combines the release-without-ransom branch of م ن ن with the ownership branch of ع ب د. It remains anchored in adjacent focus words and is sharpened by the later expulsion threat; downstream prose should qualify it as a paradoxical echo of release from communal claims while remaining God's servant, not as the primary lexical reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَمُنُّ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ

activation_trace.role: Release without exchange supplies the exploratory legal image of divine man.
Bondage and ownership preserve the paradox that release from one claim does not mean autonomy from God.
Entrusting the affair to God supplies the destination of the released allegiance.
Threatened expulsion makes the community's attempted control of the messengers spatially concrete.

changed_reading.before: Divine favor grants a special status inside the community.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, divine selection releases the messenger from the community's ownership claims without releasing the messenger from divine servanthood.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain and form-distant because it joins human skin or surface, pictured likeness, and the illuminating-oil branch of س ل ط. It remains anchored in three focus roots and the surah's earlier light destination; downstream prose should render it only as an imagistic overlay showing where distinction appears, not as lexical equivalence for بشر, مثل, or سلطان.

activation_trace.role: Visible skin and surface supply the plane on which human sameness is perceived.
A pictured model supplies an exploratory image of matching outward form.
Illuminating oil supplies a form-distant image for a permitted disclosure carried through an ordinary human surface.
Light supplies the surah-local destination that keeps the illumination image from becoming free association.

changed_reading.before: Human likeness makes the messenger visually and ontologically indistinguishable from the hearers.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, the same human surface carries permitted illumination; distinction appears in disclosed light, not in a changed human body.

strongest_changes: The opponents' 'humans like us' wording becomes the messengers' conceded premise, while its disqualifying inference is reversed.
The later denial of sultan alongside call and response separates persuasion from coercive jurisdiction and preserves hearer accountability.
The good-word sequence recasts permission-bound efficacy as rooted speech that yields and stabilizes over time.
Immediate repetition under harm and the later promise make trust sustained guided action rather than passive compensation.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition consistently preserves human parity while redistributing agency: human carriers speak, clarify, endure, and deliver; permission governs efficacy; hearers answer; God owns selection, authorization, and outcome.
remaining_uncertainties: Sultan keeps both proof and power branches live; the context sharpens their contrast without forcing one final sense.
The causal reading of permission and the transfer from the word-tree sequence to focus sultan are reader-supplied inferences.
The cutting, release, and illuminating-oil activations are branch resonances only and should not replace the focus words' primary local senses.
